balls.text: swatted off the good length as Mukesh lets slip the slower ball. They set off for the second, as well they might, but Varun gets sent back.
wide yorker, nails his length this time, Russell reaches with a fishing rod but only gets a nibble of toe-end

it's going south at a rate of knots for Mukesh! Leg-sided, inches short of the yorker, room to get that muscular blade under the slot, with a front foot flung towards the square leg umpire. Over backward square this time
another massive mash, high over deep midwicket! Enormous strike from Russ, 109 metres, hit up and over the stands, onto the approach road! Mukesh again missed by a couple of inches
here we go, Mukesh misses, Dre Russ hits! Maybe six inches too short, the yorker becomes a slot ball, and gets deposited with an open stance over cow corner
well-set field as Russell winds into his favoured slam through the full length, but wide long-on gathers calmly
rocks back, guides a cut out to point, all he can do is not get out. It's down to the last six balls for Russell to give KKR something
flicked to the leg side, takes the single. Varun has one ball to face
faster and tighter line, that's zippy, 117kph, and skips onto Russell before he can line up a forceful response
spins past the pads. Another incremental boost to the total
back of a length, and a miscue from Russ flies down towards long-on, on the bounce, off the stickers. And he immediately blames his tools, and calls for a new bat
fiicked around the front pad, finds space on the leg side. Now then...
looped up from over the wicket, pressed with a full face to the off side
bouncer, well directed, Russ ducks but that's the end of another wonderful spell. 2 for 20 for Nortje, to go with Ishant's 2 for 19
wonderful yorker. Russell's levers don't have an answer for that line, tailing into his toes
another yorker, speared in the air, up and over the leg side. Lands in space, short of the sweeper, and again, no run taken
whistles past the pads, as the yorker does slightly awry
smashed out to the leg side, but can't find the gap so doesn't take the run
rocks back, has a hack! Russ doesn't care where it goes, so long as it goes! Was aiming down the ground but a fat edge through deep third will suffice

clattered off the full length, back at the bowler! In the slot for the big wind-up, and that's going to hurt! Right on the right ankle as Nortje jumps into the way and out of the way at the same time... ouch
rolls the fingers, tighter line, back of a length. Poked down into the crease and he's done the needful
bouncer, down the leg side. Varun flinches out of the way and up comes the 100 to ironic cheers
another yorker, cuffed to long-on, and that is a wonderful over. All Russ can do is pick off the single and give Varun one ball to survive
full toss, inswinging into the pads, connection on the swing, but straight at short backward square
that is sublime. Switches off the engine and floats the yorker into the toes like a doodlebug. Dre can only stab it down at his feet
overdoes the yorker this time, comes out as a full toss down the leg side
attacking the toes again, that's exceptional bowling, no room for Russell to swing his arms, thumping the pads outside the line of leg
fired into the toes, well directed, nothing Russell can do with that one
back of a length, Varun does well enough to steer it to the off side. Over to you, Russ...
bouncer, down the leg side. Every little helps for KKR at this stage
dipping into the toes and dug out reasonably well

flapped back to the bowler! Short and sharp, into the body, Yadav steps back in a self-preservatory pull, it comes off the stickers and loops into space. Nortje thunders through in his followthrough, and clings on well
swivels into a pull, not quite timed into the leg side
on the back foot, punched to the off side
up on the toes, sharp pace from Nortje, 143.8kph for his comeback ball, pressed to cover

back of a length, flicked airily to the on-side, and if there'd been a short midwicket, that would have been curtains too! On that evidence, it's Dre or bust for KKR... but we kind of knew that already

Roy is pinned lbw first-ball! It's been reviewed, but this looked mighty adjacent. And if so, this might be the biggest self-own in Impact Sub history... sure enough, it's clipping the top of the bails and off he goes!

sweep, and a big top-edge to backward square! Roy's grind is done... he didn't have much chance for fluency with wickets tumbling around him, but that's the wrong moment to fall. Had to take it on, but Kuldeep's extra bounce does him in
reverse-sweep, solid connection, but straight at point
swings into the sweep, front foot thrust down the pitch. Can't connect
tucked into the gap to rotate the strike
very full, attacking the base of the stumps and poked into the covers
bouncer, too short from the square-leg umpire's liking
attacks the pads, back of a length again, Roy pivots into a pull and can't connect as they pinch the bye
width for Roy, that's gold-dust and he's slapped that eagerly through deep backward point!
back of a length, better areas from Marsh, pressed to the off side
planked into the stands! Here comes Dre Russ, pace off the ball, in his arc, deep in the crease, and creamed over deep midwicket
back of a length and hauled to the on-side
tailing into the toes, and clipped to the on-side for the single. Roy is going to have to bat through here and hope to give KKR 140-odd. It'll be quite something to get anything more from here
on the hips, nudged to the on-side
short, slammed, and Yadav at short midwicket pounces brilliantly! Diving to his left to save a certain four
on the back foot, angled in to Russell at 146.4kph. Sharp
attempted ramp, hits the back of Roy's bat as he inverts his stance, but he gets the single to deep third all the same
opens the face on the back foot and tapped to backward point
back of a length, tight line, tapped into the covers. Sharma is putting in a shift for his winless team here!
lift on a wide line, Russell pushes with hard hands outside his eyes and nearly nicks off to the short ball
flashed off the back foot, slower ball, Roy takes the single as well he might. He's trapped behind a rock and a hard place now
very full length, opens the face for a steer out to point

picks out deep midwicket! Narine comes crashing down too, as Sharma drags his length back, tempts the pull, but again finds enough flick through his wrist to confound those attacking intentions. Warner is inside the rope to pocket the chance, and well, it's time for Russell the Muscle now... KKR have no other options!
opens the face on the back foot, guided to point
fired past the legs, we'll have that again
delicately picked off through deep third. A few more of those would be handy. More turn and bounce, but Narine waited on the back foot, opened the face and let the pace on the ball do the talking
nurdled around the pads to the on-side
on the back foot, wide line and flapped to cover
tucked off the pads to the on-side

flipped off the toes, and straight to deep square leg! Axar's accuracy demands he try something a little funky to keep things moving, but once again, that overspin prevents Rinku from maintaining control of the stroke. It flew fast but straight to a well-placed fielder, and now KKR are properly in the soup without a ladle
tight line, over the wicket to the left-hander, high-handed block back down the line
tossed up and tapped to the on-side for another single
down on one knee, and swept hard to deep backward square
rocks back, and cut on the up to deep point
flatter, and into the pads, no room for Roy to make the big wind-up, and works the single to leg
heave ho! Roy plants the front foot, and monsters a huge blow down the ground. He has fond memories of Kuldeep...
head over the ball and blocked
back of a length, more taxing bounce as Axar draws his man forward, point gathers
up on the toes, prodded to the on-side
reverse-sweep, and that's a better connection! Picked up off middle and off, rolls the wrists on impact, timed through backward point
over the wicket, tight line on the front foot, and poked back to the bowler
reverses the hands, makes a horlicks of the attempted ramp, loses his middle stump! Mandeep's innings ends in ignominy and KKR are sinking in a rush
back of a length and flapped to the on-side for a single
Marsh drops a clanger! Off his own bowling too... An ungainly flap across the line, a huge top-edge, Marsh had to make good ground but just muffed it at the last
on the back foot, thumped hard into the covers
has to adjust as Marsh sneaks in the slower ball, soft hands pressed out to cover
picked up, off the toes, high over backward square! Full length from Marsh but shaped into his toes
attempted flick off the legs, can't create the power as Marsh hits his length well, just back of the slot
short, and down the leg side, no need to chase that one
full length, pushed back to the bowler
flicked with the turn to the leg side again, finds a hint of space as they rush back for two. Roy would have been struggling with a direct hit from the deep there
pushed with hard hands, into the off side
attempted reverse sweep as Roy plants his foot outside the line of off and can't connect
on the back foot, flicked to the on-side
takes on the reverse-slog but can't connect. Turn and bounce spares the lbw appeal
round the wicket, hint of grip goes nowhere
action replay as Warner flings himself at the stumps again! More tip and run, another all-action gather and flick, and just about home to complete a less-than-impressive powerplay for KKR
wider line, poked to point
poked into the covers, but Warner's shy goes wide! Direct hit would have been mighty tight, he gathered and released in a flash as the batter had to deviate around Ishant in his followthrough
pushed back down the pitch, into the off side

climbs through the line and holes out to mid-on! No connection whatsoever on his launch down the ground, high on the bat and spooned to Mukesh, running back at the edge of the circle. Another wicket lost in the powerplay, and the pressure is now well and truly on
flicked out to deep square leg, very full and into the toes
thumped off the back foot, into the covers as Mukesh gets out of his over with a good tight line to the left-hander. Just two off the over, and KKR are in neutral for the moment
banged in short, ducks
through to the keeper, outside off, no stroke offered as Iyer settles for a few sighters, with Delhi's quicks showing their teeth at the moment
reaches for the wide line, under-edged to the on-side, takes the single through square leg
crashing drive, on the front foot, straight into the covers
short and sharp, Roy attempts a pull but can't connect, keeper does well to pounce on the deflection
speared out past the tramlines, Roy shapes to drive but settles for the wide
takes the edge again!  Reaches second slip on the bounce, but that's an outstanding attacking over. Still goes for nine, but KKR very much on the back foot in so doing
full again, straighter line, Nitish gets enough bat on that to tickle it off his pads, away through fine leg. 148.3kph... that's warm
two slips now, and they are in business on that length! Full, threatening, pushed past off stump, and left alone with a late decision

edged to slip! It's Test match cricket at the Feroz Shah Kotla! Hits the pitch hard, climbing into a hard-handed drive, a fat edge, and a sharp take at a solitary wide slip from Marsh. Iyer makes a duck, and now KKR are under pressure
makes room to leg, Nortje follows him with a 140.7kph yorker, and they take the deflection off the pads
full length, but a fraction of width and ping! Roy flaps through the ball with an open face and takes it on through deep third
swing across the left-hander, on a good length, and an old-school leave to complete the over
wider outside off, Roy lines up the cut but doesn't time it perfectly, out to backward point
snorter! This one kicks off a tighter line, and so nearly kisses the splice as Roy just about plays inside the line
flicked with dismissive power, through midwicket! More good signs for Roy...
fired out past the batter, way out on the off side. Not given as a wide as Roy had shaped across his crease, but that's a tight call...
angled bat on the front foot, eased into the covers

spooned to square leg! A bit of a nothing shot from Litton, who swung through the short ball, but was never in control with the ball outside his eyeline. A simple top-edge looped to Yadav with no power whatsoever, and Delhi have their incision
plinked off the pads, out through the leg side. Deep backward square tidies up
fired down the leg side. Reload!
bottom-handed thump! Very encouraging signs for Roy in that stroke, more measure movements as he leans forward and lifts his drive along the ground (so to speak) clean through the covers
a skitter to the pitch, and Roy misses with a lusty swing to leg as the ball skids low past his leg stump, through a yawning gate
hits the pitch a touch harder, bottom hand comes off the bat in defence to the leg side
flicked off the toes, hard through deep midwicket! That's a freebie to give Roy's innings a leg-up, taken from middle with hard wrists
slower ball, full length outside off, met with an open face and an exploratory push into the point region
flicked around the front pad to the on-side
solid connection! That's exquisite from Litton, leaning onto the front foot, a bit of width on a full length, and caressed with power through the covers, like a Tiger stroking a tiger
tighter line, angling in on the pads, Roy flicks to midwicket to open his account
lovely bendy ball, back in on a full length, Roy jabs with hard hands and pushes without timing into the covers
hits a familiar length outside off, with a hint of wobble back towards the bat, Roy leaves alone
full toss on off, and lofted between long-on and deep midwicket. Axar looks relieved, as DC win their first match in six attempts
another yorker, as it angles into leg. Flicked to deep square, and they pick two again. And to add to DC's aid, it is a no-ball

Narine at short fine can't collect on the bounce, and that allows an extra run. He rushes across to his left, and stops a potential four though. Then he throws the ball at the keeper's end, with Axar diving back and making it safely. Before that, it was a yorker bang on middle, which Axar jammed at
very full on off, and drilled to long-on

another stumping chance missed by Litton?! Looked like it, since he clipped the bails only after collecting the ball on the second attempt. Yorker length outside off, as Axar jumped down and tried to slash but missed. He was wayyy outside the crease, only for Litton to fumble. And it was only when Axar dragged his bat in did Litton act
charges down, and nudges this short ball heading down leg to long-on
almost rolled on to the stumps! Full and slow outside off, as he got a bottom edge towards square leg while trying to slog sweep
short on middle, and pushed aerially to long-on. Not sure why Rana went short there, after getting some turn and grip earlier in the day
full on off, and he hoicks across the line to deep square leg, and again off the inside half of the bat
short outside off, and punched along the ground to long-off

appeal from the Litton for a potential leg-before decision as well as caught, since the slip fielder dived forward to take the ball. Rana reviews again, after it's given not out. There is not involved, as Axar tries to clip this good length ball, and guess what, it pitches outside leg. So all the excitement goes to hell
looks for the big slog, but is beaten. Full and tossed up outside off, and he slogged across the line
turns away off a shortish length, and ends on off. Punched to long-on
Litton misses an easy stumping! Lalit was way down the pitch, but Litton couldn't even collect it. Length ball wide-ish of off, and Lalit pushed but missed

beats his outside edge! But hang on, Rana has reviewed for a potential leg-before wicket. From the back of the hand on a good length on off, and replays show there is no outside edge as Axar tried to block forward. His bat ended around middle stump, as the ball passed the outside edge. So the ball hit him on the back thigh, and replays show the ball would have zoomed way over the stumps. So it's not out. Meanwhile, they ran a leg bye, as the ball dribbled towards short third
full on off, and pushed back, as Rana fields the ball to his right
good length ball angling across to end on off. Pulled to deep midwicket
just over midwicket! Ah, that looked close. Full ball heading into leg, and chipped forward by Lalit. Khejroliya at midwicket stuck his left hand up, but it didn't come
fullish ball on off, and he goes low to tap at that

gone, great delivery! The ball straightened after pitching on a length on off stump. Rana flicked that ball from the front of the hand, with Aman pushing forward at it from middle stump. Perhaps he thought it would turn in, which it didn't. Still some hope for KKR?
short just outside off. Cut away to deep point
full and heads on straight on to off. Tucked to midwicket off the inside half of the bat

lofted to long-on! Is there some late twist yet? The ball was tossed up, and full, going on with the angle from around the wicket. It ended around middle and off, and he ended up chipping to right into the fielder's lap
keeps low off a good length on off. Punched to long-on
makes room, and the bowler goes full outside leg. Wide again, as he lets it go
skips down to this shortish ball on the stumps, and pushes to long-on
full and wide of off. He heaves, but mistimes it, as it comes off the inside half of the bat to deep square
fullish, and sliding down leg. Left alone, and wide called
good length on the stumps. Pulled to deep midwicket
smacked to deep backward point! A late cut from Axar, as he sees the ball short and wide of off. An over with just two from the first three balls ends with nine off the last three
good length, as it straightens outside off. Tapped towards point for a quick single
shortish outside off, with a hint of turn in. Pulled to deep midwicket, from where Russell rushes to his left but lets the ball through. Long-on, behind him, missed it too, and so that was four
short on off, and punched to wide long-off
short again, but on middle, as it hints to turn away. Pulled to deep square
short and wide-ish of off - how many times has he bowled that today? - but Pandey finds point with his poke
again gets good bounce off a length from leg, as it turns away. Tapped down, as it is a wicket maiden
extra bounce off a good length, and straightens on middle. Dabbed down
turns away, and beats him! Fullish on middle, and goes away, as Axar misses his clip
turns away off a shorter length from outside off. Punched to extra cover again
good length, turning in from outside off. Punched to extra cover

confident appeal for leg before, and given! Warner looked plumb, and he walks back immediately, even as he reviews. The ball hit his front boot as he got down to reverse sweep, as it was flicked full, and was dipping while being angled towards the leg side. It hit him right on the base of the boot, and replays show the ball would have hit leg stump
good length, turning into middle. Clipped to deep midwicket
full just outside off, and pushed to long-on
keeps veryyyy low off a good length, as it angles down leg. Warner was perhaps hit on his boot as tried to clip but missed, and the ball trickled away
short again, but closer to off. Again cut away, now to point's right
turns away off a good length from outside off. Pulled to deep backward square
short and wide of off. He reaches out and slams it to deep point
length ball on his pads. Clipped to deep square
slower, and loopy, on a full length on off. Pushed back
straightens off a good length outside off, as he dabs to short third
turns away off a short of a length, and ends outside off. Pulled to fine leg
hint of turn away off a shortish length on middle. Pulled to deep square
short ball, turning into middle. Pulled to deep midwicket
full and on middle. Anukul dives to his left to cut that off
the umpire ducks for life! Pandey clubs that 90 degrees, as this very full and straight ball arrives, and he jumps out of the crease to loft
short ball on the stumps, and pulled to deep square leg
short and wide of off, and finds extra cover with his swat
fifty for Warner! Another slog sweep to fine leg, as this full ball heads down the leg side. He gets down on his back knee, and slams that back
skips down, and Roy slows it down to go on a short length on middle. Turns away too, and pushed to long-on
leading edge, almost chipped back to the bowler. Full and hint of turn away to finish on middle and leg, as Warner tried to flick
full and a bit wide of off. Cut away to point
short ball outside off. Pulled to long-on
full ball angled into leg. Pushed to long-on
quite full and outside off. Dragged from outside off to long-on
yorker length on middle and off, and driven to long-off
short ball on middle and leg, and pulled to deep midwicket
bowls short, and turns it away to finish it outside off. Pulled to long-on
keeps bowling full and on the stumps. Again nudged back to the bowler
again full on off, and flatter. Driven to extra cover
full and straight, and pushed back to the bowler

gifted back to the bowler! A simple catch to his left for Anukul, as Salt chipped back a full delivery going on with the arm on off, and on a full length. Looked like the ball held on to the pitch for once there, with the slowness coming into play
shortish, and goes on straight on middle. Again pushed to extra cover
Rana stops in his delivery while coming from around, and bowls on a good length on off. Punched to extra cover
turns in off a good length on off. Pushed to long-on
creamed wide of long-off! It was aerial for a second, but between extra cover and the bowler. Quite full just outside off, and he hit that hard

taken at long-off! Good catch by sub fielder Wiese, who almost lost balance on the boundary after overrunning to his right. The length was perhaps barely a bit too full on off for Marsh to try and belt that down the ground. In the end he did hit hard and flat, only for among the taller of the fielders to gobble it above his head
good length on off, and punched to extra cover
shortish outside off, and cut away to deep point
full and straight, and slower this time. Tucked back to the bowler
very full on leg, and pushed back towards the non-striker
yorker length on middle, and jammed down the pitch
comes in with the angle from around the wicket, and keeps low off a good length just outside off. Finds cover
ah, some turn there. Good length on middle, but finishes on off, as Marsh dabs it down
good length just outside off. Pushed to extra cover
launched down the ground! DC are motoring along. Short ball again, and turning in to end on a comfortable line, as Warner makes room and swats it back
pulled wide of mid-on! Short ball on middle and off, as he makes room and swipes it hard to keep piling the pain on KKR
good length, angling down leg. Left alone, and wide called
again slog swept over short fine! Much fuller length, but again heading into the leg side. With fine leg up, Warner dispatches it
good length, angling into leg. Nudged down to the on side
one-bounce four over fine leg! Shortish ball on off, and turning into leg, as Warner slog-pulls over short fine
much fuller on middle and leg, and slog swept to fine leg, which was placed a bit wider
the square-leg fielder dives to his right, but can't get a hand. Short delivery, hinting to turn in, as Warner went down on his back knee, and crashed a pull to deep square
good length, turning onto leg. Clipped to deep backward square

chops on! The angle from around the wicket coming into play. He flicked one from back of the hand, and on a good length around off. The ball angled away a bit, and didn't bounce as per Shaw's liking. The ball has gripped here this evening, and Shaw's attempted cut ended in a bottom edge on to off stump
slower now, on a shortish length on leg. Tries to pull but is hit on his pad
cut away between point and short third! Short, quick and turning in towards middle and off, and flashed by Shaw in the gap
short and wide of off, but he finds cover with his slash
good length ball turning into leg. Clipped to deep midwicket
shortish on middle, and flicked to square leg
cuts it late, as the shortish ball turns into leg. Placed to short third's left
keeps a bit low off a good length, turning into middle and leg from around middle stump. Clipped to deep midwicket
floats it full on off. Pushed to cover

Rinku at deep backward square runs and dives to his right, but has he managed to save a few runs? Replays show he pulled the ball back, and yeah, has saved two. Short ball from Russell, and again crunched hard by Warner
he is standing outside leg, and Russell bowls on a shortish length while angling it in to him him high on the body, as Warner missed his clip
extra bounce off a shortish length on off, as he tries to ramp but is beaten
good length ball on off, and swatted to extra cover. The bounce seemed to have surprised him there
to deep midwicket again! Warner showing glimpses of his best. Short delivery around middle, and he pulled while staying deep in the crease
clubbed between the bowler and mid-on! That was aerial, but hit very hard. On a hitting length, and angling slightly into middle and leg. Pushed back for four
starts with a slower ball, on a full length om off. Driven wide of mid-on, and it's also a no-ball
full toss on middle, and only nudged to midwicket. Missed out on a scoring chance there
pulls but it comes off the bottom of the bat, with the ball trickling to mid-on. Short in length on middle and off this time
hacked between point and extra cover! A lot of room for him to play with, as the ball is short and wide of off. He cuts forcefully for four to deep point
pulled behind the wicket! Looked like it came off the glove, before heading to the keeper's right. Short delivery, angling down the leg side, as Warner pulled while getting on top of the bounce
misfield by the midwicket fielder, with Varun placed there. Good length on the stumps, and clipped by Shaw
swatted beyond mid-off! Shorter side of a length, and angling across to end a bit wide of off. Shaw rides the bounce, and plays it to the left of mid-off
good bouncer on middle stump, as the ball carries nicely to the keeper after Warner sways out of the way
almost a yorker on sixth stump, which he drags to mid-on off the inside half of the bat
good length on the stumps, and clipped to deep backward square
good length on middle, and swiped to deep backward square
rammed to deep midwicket! Short delivery from Umesh, again angling away to end slightly wide of off, and with good bounce. Pulled hard for four
shorter side of a length, angling across to finish on top of off. Pushed to the point fielder's left
